title: The Maple Street Compost Contamination Dilemma
setting: Nestled between the library’s back porch and a row of overgrown tomato plants, Maple Street’s neighborhood compost drop-off consists of three weathered wooden bins tagged with handwritten rules. For 18 months, volunteers Marisol and Jules ran the program without incident, collecting food scraps weekly until a batch of unlabeled dairy waste spoiled nearly 70% of the pile last Tuesday. The resulting foul stench has carried to nearby townhomes, prompting three residents to file formal complaints with the neighborhood association.

characters.name: Marisol Espinoza
characters.tendencies: Insists on sticking strictly to the initial program guidelines to rebuild trust with local residents after the contamination incident

characters.name: Jules Torres
characters.tendencies: Argues that bending the program rules temporarily to add free contamination testing stations will prevent future waste spoilage

characters.name: Clara Hale
characters.tendencies: Demands the compost program be shut down entirely unless immediate, permanent changes are made to eliminate the persistent foul stench
